pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:0.6: Ime kho panāyyāyo sekhiyā Dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.4: ‘‘kathañhi nāma bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsessanti, seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyo’’ti!
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.5: Assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khiyyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.6: Yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā…pe… tā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti –
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.7: ‘‘kathañhi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsessantī’’ti…pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.8: saccaṃ kira, bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsentīti?
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.11: kathañhi nāma, bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsessanti!
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.13: evañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu –
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.16: Yā anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambentī nivāseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
